description: Canonical accountability events for changes after the underlying charging/program record. Events require primary-source linkage and do not rewrite charge-era case files.

events.subject: Mekfira Hussein
events.summary: Sentenced to 57 months after a guilty plea.

events.subject: Abduljabar Hussein
events.summary: Sentenced to 40 months after a guilty plea.

events.subject: Kaamil Omar Sallah
events.summary: Returned to Minnesota and appeared in court on existing wire-fraud charges; no later legal stage is implied.

events.subject: Minnesota Medicaid program integrity
events.summary: DHS published updated revalidation, enforcement and recovery-identification activity metrics. These are implementation/output measures, not demonstrated effectiveness.

events.subject: Sharon Denise Ross
events.summary: Ross was ordered to forfeit property derived from fraud proceeds, including her Willernie house. The source does not state a dollar value.

events.subject: Abdi Nur Salah
events.summary: Sentenced to 33 months after a guilty plea; USAO-MN identified him as the 31st Feeding Our Future defendant sentenced.

events.subject: Hassan Ahmed Hussein
events.summary: Pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud in the Pristine Health HSS case; sentencing remains later.

events.subject: Ahmed Abdirashid Mohamed
events.summary: Pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud in the Pristine Health HSS case; sentencing remains later.

events.subject: Shaakir Mohamud Ibrahim
events.summary: Indicted in an alleged $1.1 million child-nutrition reimbursement scheme. Allegations are not findings; no charged-defendant ordinal is inferred.

events.subject: Sharmaine Meadows
events.summary: Jury convicted Meadows of three health-care-fraud counts; DOJ reports more than $3.6 million paid to her company, not recovered. Sentencing pending.

events.subject: Emily Marice Ravits
events.summary: Indicted over allegedly false EIDBI supervision certifications; DOJ describes a $7.7 million alleged scheme. Not a conviction.

events.subject: Feisal Mohamed Elmi
events.summary: Indicted in an alleged $8.2 million EIDBI billing case. Not a conviction.

events.subject: Habiba Mohamed
events.summary: Charged by information in an alleged $19.1 million EIDBI scheme involving previously charged co-conspirators; do not add overlapping scheme totals.

events.subject: Faiza Osman Ahmed
events.summary: Indicted in an alleged $10 million Medicaid scheme involving home supports, personal care assistance and night supervision.

events.subject: Jama Yusuf Mohamod
events.summary: Indicted in an alleged $3.2 million Integrated Community Supports billing case.

events.subject: Muna Wais Fidhin
events.summary: Jury convicted Fidhin of nine counts involving Feeding Our Future and Partners in Nutrition food sites. Sentencing pending.

events.subject: Salim Ahmed Said
events.summary: Sentenced to 360 months for Feeding Our Future fraud. DOJ describes more than $44 million in proceeds facilitated; no collection established.

events.subject: Nicole Lee Slegers and Shaun Hubert Slegers
events.summary: Both pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit wire fraud involving estates of deceased Medicaid recipients; reported $144,524 obtained through vehicle transfers. Distinct from provider-claim reimbursement fraud.

events.subject: Said Farah
events.summary: Sentenced to 78 months and $40,000 fine for juror bribery; a separate offense from the underlying food-fraud trial and not a food-fraud conviction.

events.subject: Three Minneapolis real properties
events.summary: Civil forfeiture action filed for three properties valued at approximately $519,000; lis pendens recorded. No completed forfeiture or recovery established.
